title: Dependency declared with a caret on a zero-zero version
description: package.json declares a caret range on a `0.0.x` version, which npm treats as an exact patch lock. The declaration looks like a range but admits only one patch, so a security fix in the next patch never installs while the manifest appears permissive.
remediation: Write the exact version the project tests, or move to a maintained major line.
limitation: It matches a caret range on a `0.0.x` version, which npm treats as an exact patch lock in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
